title: US Consumer Prices Rise 0.4% in October, Exceeding Forecasts as Fed Hike Looms (UPDATED)
summary: U.S. consumer prices rose 0.4% in October from the prior month, exceeding the 0.3% rate economists expected but slower than September’s 0.6% pace, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data released Tuesday.
